criteria.name: Final JSON structure and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested top-level keys, all five test booleans, score 5, final label prolonged_lowland_storage_supported, and rejected diagnosis short_burst_only.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a mostly complete JSON ledger with one missing field or a synonymous final label; award 1 point for a readable but incomplete structured answer.

criteria.name: Duration and accumulation calculations
criteria.description: Computes 137 event days, 46 precipitation days, 33.6 percent coverage, and the three mean precipitation values within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct duration or precipitation values with one rounding or product omission; award 1 point for only identifying that rainfall was substantial.

criteria.name: Satellite agreement and concentration ratios
criteria.description: Computes satellite mean 311.166 mm, GPM-CHIRPS gap 0.649 mm, gap percentage 0.2 percent, and max-to-mean ratios 1.490, 2.015, and 1.886.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct formulas with minor arithmetic errors; award 1 point for using the right products but missing either the agreement or ratio test.

criteria.name: Threshold scoring
criteria.description: Marks all five tests true and computes the score as 5 out of 5 using the stated thresholds.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one incorrect test state; award 1 point for recognizing the overall label without showing the component scoring.

criteria.name: Reasoning path and rejected diagnosis
criteria.description: Ties the passed tests to prolonged lowland storage and rejects short_burst_only using accumulation, agreement, ratio, and persistence metrics.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a plausible explanation that misses one or two required metric links.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation discipline
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation to one calculation-bound event consequence without management steps or a broad disaster essay.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a mostly concise interpretation with minor extra narrative.
